items.title: US Spot Bitcoin ETF Daily Net Flows ($ millions)
items.description: Daily net flows into US spot bitcoin ETFs since late July 2026, in $ millions; the chart's latest bars (through Nov 13) are a run of red outflow days.
items.reason: IBIT logged a record $541M outflow on Nov 19 and bitcoin slipped below $62K, extending the ETF-led selling streak.

items.title: Strategy's preferred stock, Feb 2025–Oct 2026: $15.5B peak, $13.9B after STRC buybacks
items.description: Strategy's outstanding preferred stock by series (STRF, STRC, STRE, STRK, STRD), Feb 2025 to Oct 2026: a $15.5B peak, down to $13.9B after STRC buybacks.
items.reason: Strategy repurchased another $228.1M of STRC below $100 in the week ending Nov 15, shrinking the stack further.

items.title: SpaceX since its IPO vs Tesla and the Nasdaq-100 (IPO price = 100)
items.description: SpaceX (SPCX) since its June 2026 IPO vs Tesla and the Nasdaq-100, all indexed to 100 at the IPO.
items.reason: HSBC upgraded Tesla to Hold and lifted its target to $359, blending in a SpaceX-acquires-Tesla scenario.

items.title: Is Nvidia the new Cisco? NVDA since ChatGPT vs CSCO in the dot-com era (start = 100)
items.description: Nvidia since the ChatGPT launch vs Cisco from the 1995 Netscape IPO through the dot-com bust, both indexed to 100 on a log scale.
items.reason: Nvidia is in a CEO transition after Jensen Huang's exit while reporting $115.8B quarterly revenue, reviving the 'new Cisco' debate.

items.title: VIX vs S&P 500 (10Y)
items.description: The S&P 500 against the VIX over the past 10 years (weekly), showing fear spikes vs the index level.
items.reason: The S&P 500 fell 2% Thursday for a sixth straight decline, now more than 8% below its October record.
